scope: Korean B2 offline text and personal-study transfer tasks. Native-human, device and audio review remain separate.

initialFindings: Early cards reproduced later replies. One transfer described the opposite action in its translations.
Movable chunks, unclear exam chronology, register shifts and a two-minute rubric that omitted the connector.
wholePathReview.recheck: Reread all ten six-turn exchanges, patterns, chip windows, blanks and probes. Early cards now model the opening stance. L1 and L5 constrain the interchangeable chips. L3 distinguishes saving work from feeling at ease. L10 makes the September decision prospective and the task checks sustained speech, a previous framing expression, an objection and a stopping rule.
remaining: Optional copy polish: the Korean closing is one sentence. Its German and English translations use two sentences.

postReviewCopyCheck.reviewer: Fresh read-only Codex reviewer for the final copy and answer presentation changes
postReviewCopyCheck.scope: Verified the five final source files against the complete reviewed versions. Reversing all eight field edits in memory reproduced all five whole-file review hashes. The four time choices have exactly one answer grounded in the 9–11 lift booking. The closing Korean, English and German summaries each express both outcomes in one sentence. All five final source and assessment hashes matched; no material findings.

lessonsRead.reason: Korean dialogue natural; them2 (privilege to leave) and them4 (one-sentence rule) land as staged; 결론은 close used, but DE/EN of the conclude move render 결론은 as 'Rat/advice'; pattern example 2 Korean (-는 대신) does not match its DE/EN (-되).
그렇다고 해서 concede correctly absorbs the 'stayed late twice' challenge; them4 asks for a number and you3 gives a time-based boundary; DE of 한마디로 rendered 'Konkret'.

Argument chain (손 vs 마음, 번 시간이 어디로 가느냐, 어디까지 들일지) is sound; but situation/caption/interlocutor describe a 'Gesprächsrunde' while them1/them2 ('이거 덕분에') clearly show a friend's own smart home as in the architecture.
-(이)라기보다는 …에 가까워요 refine carrier used; 제 말은 rebut grounded in 지하철 삼 분; conditional close works; DE base switches du (them) → Sie (you3) within one lesson.
Subject-honorific illustration (동생은 가요/할머니는 가세요) is linguistically correct and the pattern rule describes it truthfully; build chunks 누구 얘기를 / 누구한테 are freely permutable in natural Korean.
Threshold view argued without opposite slogan; 꼭 그렇지는 않아요 + 제 경우에는 handle them2; pattern highlights 제 경우에는 while carrierTags/moveBlank target 꼭 그렇지는 않아요; term 불안 DE glossed 'Unsicherheit'.
…다고 봐요 open, 그렇게만 보기는 어려워요 rebut with concrete counterexample, 결국 close naming keep/change; respectful 해요체 toward older relative maintained.
-다는 점은 인정해요 concede then 다만 own contribution; principle extracted on them4; interlocutor role 'Careers-event interviewer' contradicts 선배님/저는 계획이 자꾸 어긋나서요 (a junior asking a senior).
Concede scale (숫자로만 보면), argue consistency, admit flying honestly and name a checkable next step; 꾸준함을 저한테 확인하는 거예요 slightly unidiomatic.
-다고 가정하면 … 반대로 … two-branch plan with -되 stopping rule, survives them2, compresses to one line; 해요체 throughout per 'else 해요체'; build has 6 chunks vs 5 in L1–9.

findings.issue: 결론은 … 보라는 거예요 is translated as 'Mein Rat ist' / 'My advice is'; the speech move frame is 'conclusion', and the terms entry glosses 결론은 as 'mein Fazit ist / my conclusion is'. Also the concessive 있어도 is placed as an afterthought.
findings.fix: de: "Mein Fazit ist: Auch wenn du jederzeit wegkannst, grüß die Leute im Viertel und bau Beziehungen auf, solange du da bist." en: "My conclusion is: even if you're free to leave, say hello to the people in your neighbourhood and build relationships while you're there." Apply identically in both locations; witnessKo unchanged.

findings.fix: targetText: "결론은 레시피를 따르되 소금만큼은 직접 맛보고 정하라는 거예요." (also exercises the architecture close frame 결론은 …-되 …는 거예요); keep base de/en; highlights unchanged.

findings.issue: Setting says 'Gesprächsrunde/discussion group', but them1 '불도 커튼도 다 자동이에요' and them2 '이거 덕분에 … 벌어요' are a friend showing their own smart home (architecture L3). Learner is primed for the wrong scene.

findings.issue: Chunks '누구 얘기를' and '누구한테' are freely permutable ('누구한테 누구 얘기를 하느냐에 따라' is equally natural); exact-order grading would unfairly reject a correct sentence.
findings.fix: chunks: ["같은 동사를","써도","누구 얘기를 누구한테","하느냐에","따라"]; distractors unchanged. recall/cloze/speak untouched.

findings.fix: de: "was meine Großmutter angeht".

lessonsRead.reason: 냐…냐로 나누기는 어려워요 reframes the dichotomy, you3 concedes the privilege, you5 is a genuine one-sentence rule; earlier 결론은='Fazit/conclusion' and 재택이냐 출근이냐 example repairs verified; build order unique (상실이냐로 carries 로), decoys 상실이었다면/나뉜대서 ungrammatical in slot; cloze/synthesis variants all fit; recall decoys contextually impossible; assessment prompt (shared flat) transfers without answering.

Redefinition ratio→boundary, concession keeps the line, you5 gives the requested number (nine o'clock); 한마디로='Kurz gesagt' fixed; 어디 있더라도 decoy replaced; 그렇다고/그렇다고 해도 both work in context; recall decoys 모서리/지평선/곡선 form-unique and absurd in context; haeyo throughout, DE 'du' consistent.

Scene now friend's own smart home, matching them1/them2; saved-hour vs feeling-relaxed contrast present; you5 'decide how far to let it in' avoids all-or-nothing; 손을 더해 decoy replaced; cloze 관건은/중요한 건 and 휴대폰이/핸드폰이 all fit; assessment (reading-group app) is a real transfer.

라기보다는…에 가까워요 compare, rebut with concrete subway example, conditional recommendation; DE them-turns now Sie-consistent with you5; synthesis frame 제 답은 조건부예요 and variants 경우에/상황에 따라 달라요 fit before the period; recall decoys 두께가/깊이가/길이가 unusable.

Build repaired by moving 누구 얘기를 into framePrefix, so order is unique; 할머니는 DE/EN now equivalent; the 가요/가세요 illustration is linguistically correct; but them2 '대부분 학생들은 … 하거든요' and them4 '초급자한테 조언' are a teacher's voice (architecture: Korean teacher), while role/situation prime 'Study partner / whether more vocabulary suffices'.

Replacement position pattern (지는 못해도 … 분명히 / 아야 … 자리도 생기고요) truthful and modelled on turn 1 (card in first room); 분명히 merged with 줄여 줘요 so no scope permutation; 불안=Angst/Unruhe fixed; threshold view argued without a fixed amount; however you5 DE/EN drop the contrast 금액이 아니라, which is the core of the conclude move against them4's demand for a figure.

쪽은 아니에요 + 은 지키면서 … 은 바꿀 수 있다고 봐요 separates purpose from form; rebut gives a counter-observation, conclusion names keep (gathering) and change (food, shopping, washing-up); respectful haeyo toward older relative; chunk 모이는 뜻은 지키면서 could in principle be inserted after 준비하는 방식은 with a pause, but that reading is marked and unlikely—not flagged.

Role corrected to junior; adaptation-not-plan, luck conceded with 점은 인정해요, principle extracted with honest 못 고를 땐 버텼고요; build order unique; recall decoy 직선을 (and weaker 곡선을) is contextually plausible with 미리 그린 게 아니라 … 옆으로 한 칸씩 옮긴 (metaphor of drawing a straight line), so a learner could reasonably pick it.

P9-specific checks (floor chunks L1–3, parked question L7) do not apply to this path; as P10 L9: scale conceded, identity/consistency argued, flying admitted with a next step; 스스로 확인하는 fixed; cloze/synthesis variants fit; build chunks 일회용품을 and 하루에 한 개 are freely permutable (하루에 한 개 일회용품을 덜 쓰는 is equally natural), so exact order grading rejects a correct sentence.

haeyo interviewer within architecture allowance; exam chronology March→September consistent across you1/you3/you5, stopping rule 'second attempt only', earned ending on either success in one sentence; cloze 두 번까지만/재시험까지만 fit; assessment is a true two-minute transfer with a real objection and no answer in prompt; but build chunk 여기 남아서 can precede 자격시험에 붙는다고 가정하면 giving a natural alternative sentence that exact grading would reject.

findings.field: dialogue[5].base (de,en) and pattern none (turn 5 not in pattern)
findings.reason: Edits at lessons/5/dialogue/5/base/de and /en applied exactly as proposed; both now render 금액이 아니라 ('nicht der Betrag, sondern ob …' / 'isn't an amount, it's whether …'), matching the Korean refusal of a figure. Turn 5 is not in the pattern, so no early give-away.

Applied as prefix '세상을 바꾸려는 건 아니에요. 일회용품을 ', chunks ['하루에 한 개','덜','쓰는','선택이','쌓이면'], suffix ' 제가 어떤 사람인지가 정해지거든요.'. Differs from the suggestion (덜/쓰는 split, 제가 어떤 사람인지가 kept in suffix) but is equivalent: 5 chips, exactly one natural order, 일회용품을 now fixed in the frame so the permutation is gone; distractors 쌓였도록/선택이라고요 remain ungrammatical in every slot; speak tokens 일회용품을/쓰는/선택이 and trophy unaffected.

Instead of fusing 가정하면 여기 남아서, the build was re-cut: prefix now ends '…자격시험에 붙는다고 가정하면 여기 남아서 ', chunks ['바로','일을 시작하고,','반대로 떨어지면','반년 더','준비해요.'], suffix ''. The 여기 남아서 permutation is eliminated; the five chips have one natural order; distractors 붙었나요/가정대로는 stay ungrammatical/unnatural in every slot. The build still exercises a pattern-inventory frame of this turn (반대로 …-면 contrast branch). speak[0].requiredTokens were consistently updated to 시작하고/떨어지면/준비해요, all present in turn 1. Not a regression.
fallbackChoices[1] 직선을→진료를 and [3] 곡선을→진동을 applied, yielding ['통로를','진료를','진로를','진동을'] as proposed; acceptedAnswers 진로를 unchanged; no decoy is now contextually plausible with 미리 그린 게 아니라.

All six edits applied exactly (Koreanischlehrerin / Korean teacher; situation and sceneCaption prefix now 'Deine Koreanischlehrerin fragt, was dir beim Lernen der Sprache am schwersten gefallen ist.' / 'Your Korean teacher asks what was hardest for you about learning the language.'), consistent with them1 and them2 in the dialogue. Korean turns, build, cloze, synthesis, speak, trophy untouched.
lessons/6/synthesis/blanks/0/acceptedAnswers now ['결국','정리하면','그러니까','한마디로']; all four are natural closing connectors before 함께 모이는 뜻은 지키고 …; 결국 remains the canonical answer.
lessons/5/synthesis/blanks/0/acceptedAnswers now ['그러니까','그래서','결국','정리하면']; 정리하면 제 기준은 금액이 아니라 … is natural and the addition is closed-set, consistent with local policy.

languageVerdict.reason: Both dialogue[5] closings are now a single sentence, as the interviewer requested (한 문장으로), and each carries both branches of 정리하면 두 번 중 한 번만 붙어도 바로 일하고, 삼월과 구월에 모두 떨어지면 다른 자리를 찾아요: pass on either attempt → start work immediately; fail in both March and September → look for another position. 'sobald ich bei einem der beiden Versuche bestehe' / 'as soon as I pass on either attempt' correctly renders 한 번만 붙어도, and the de/en versions are mutually consistent and match the synthesis segment.

fields.before: Zusammengefasst beginne ich sofort zu arbeiten, sobald ich bei einem der beiden Versuche bestehe. Falle ich sowohl im März als auch im September durch, suche ich eine andere Stelle.
fields.after: Zusammengefasst beginne ich sofort zu arbeiten, sobald ich bei einem der beiden Versuche bestehe, und suche mir eine andere Stelle, falls ich sowohl im März als auch im September durchfalle.

fields.before: To sum up, I’ll start work as soon as I pass on either attempt. If I fail in both March and September, I’ll look for another role.
fields.after: In short, I’ll start work as soon as I pass on either attempt, and if I fail in both March and September, I’ll look for another role.
